    How they are built

    Same rules in every bot.

    01

    One job

    Each bot has a single, clear job and says so in one line when you ask for something else.

    02

    You approve

    Bots that write to people draft first. Emails, posts, and messages go out only when you say so.

    03

    Nothing invented

    No made up prices, dimensions, emails, or reviews. When a bot cannot find something, it says so.

    04

    Plain voice

    Short, specific answers with no hype and no filler, and at most one question before work starts.

    Templates run on Grok Bot. Bots made by third party users act on your behalf, so review what they draft.
